---
title: "exRNA Atlas — Plasma miRNA Count Matrix (KJENS1-PDD Study)"
subtitle: "Capstone: exRNA biomarkers in neurodegenerative disease"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## 1. Setup

Set the paths below to match your environment. `work_dir` is where downloads and
outputs are written; `meta_path` points to the metadata TSV exported from the
exRNA Atlas.

```{r config}
# --- Paths (edit these) 
work_dir  <- "data/capstone"                       # working dir for downloads/outputs
meta_path <- "data/exRNA_Atlas_Donor_Metadata.tsv" # metadata TSV export

dir.create(work_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# The exRNA Atlas serves large files; give downloads plenty of time.
options(timeout = 600)

# hg38 / exceRpt v5.0.0 data, Plasma biofluid, KJENS1-PDD study
base <- "https://exrna-atlas.org/ftps/exRNA-atlas/AtlasV3.0_data/Plasma/KJENS1yrpQwk/"
```

## 2. Load sample metadata

The metadata TSV has a block of `#` comment lines at the top; `comment.char = "#"`
skips them. Columns include CONDITION, BIOFLUID, and the ERCC QC pass/fail flag.

```{r metadata}
meta <- read.delim(
  meta_path,
  header           = TRUE,
  sep              = "\t",
  comment.char     = "#",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names      = FALSE
)

cat("Metadata:", nrow(meta), "samples x", ncol(meta), "fields\n\n")
print(table(meta$CONDITION))                                  # samples per condition
cat("\n")
print(table(meta$CONDITION, meta$`MEETS ERCC QC STANDARDS?`)) # condition x QC
```

## 3. Download + extract miRNA counts for every sample

For each sample folder, this downloads the `CORE_RESULTS_v5.0.0.tgz` archive,
pulls out the single `readCounts_miRNAmature_sense.txt` file, and keeps the
`totalReadCount` per mature miRNA.

- `MV_` and `V3_` prefixed folders are library-prep / pipeline re-runs of the
  same donors, so they're dropped to avoid counting donors more than once.
- A pause + retry-with-backoff handles the server's rate limiting (HTTP 429).

```{r download-merge}
dir.create(file.path(work_dir, "tgz"),       showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(work_dir, "extracted"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- list sample folders from the directory index ---
idx     <- readLines(base)
folders <- regmatches(idx, regexpr('href="[^"]+/"', idx))
folders <- sub('href="', '', sub('/"$', '', folders))
folders <- folders[folders != ".." & nzchar(folders)]
folders <- folders[!grepl("^MV_|^V3_", folders)]   # drop rerun duplicates
cat("Sample folders to process:", length(folders), "\n")

count_list <- list()

for (fld in folders) {
  url  <- paste0(base, fld, "/", fld, ".fastq_CORE_RESULTS_v5.0.0.tgz")
  dest <- file.path(work_dir, "tgz", paste0(fld, ".tgz"))

  # --- download with retry + backoff (handles HTTP 429 rate limiting) ---
  if (!file.exists(dest) || file.size(dest) == 0) {
    for (attempt in 1:5) {
      res <- tryCatch(
        { download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE); 0 },
        error = function(e) 1, warning = function(w) 1
      )
      if (res == 0 && file.exists(dest) && file.size(dest) > 0) break
      Sys.sleep(5 * attempt)          # wait 5s, 10s, 15s, 20s between retries
    }
  }
  if (!file.exists(dest) || file.size(dest) == 0) { cat("dl fail:", fld, "\n"); next }

  # --- find & extract the mature-miRNA counts file inside the archive ---
  inside <- tryCatch(untar(dest, list = TRUE), error = function(e) character(0))
  mir    <- grep("readCounts_miRNAmature_sense\\.txt$", inside, value = TRUE)
  if (length(mir) == 0) { cat("no miRNA in:", fld, "\n"); next }

  untar(dest, files = mir[1], exdir = file.path(work_dir, "extracted"))
  d <- read.delim(file.path(work_dir, "extracted", mir[1]), sep = "\t",
                  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # clean miRNA name = text before the first ":" ; sum any duplicate names
  d$miRNA <- sub(":.*", "", d$ReferenceID)
  agg     <- aggregate(totalReadCount ~ miRNA, data = d, FUN = sum)
  count_list[[fld]] <- setNames(agg$totalReadCount, agg$miRNA)

  cat("done:", fld, "(", length(count_list), "of", length(folders), ")\n")
  Sys.sleep(2)                        # polite pause between samples
}

cat("\nSamples successfully read:", length(count_list), "\n")
```

## 4. Build the miRNA × sample count matrix

```{r build-matrix}
all_mir <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(count_list, names))))
mat <- sapply(count_list, function(v) { x <- v[all_mir]; x[is.na(x)] <- 0; x })
rownames(mat) <- all_mir
mat <- round(mat)                     # integer counts for DESeq2

cat("Count matrix:", nrow(mat), "miRNAs x", ncol(mat), "samples\n")
mat[1:5, 1:min(3, ncol(mat))]         # peek
```

## 5. Match samples to condition labels

Attaches each sample's CONDITION (from the metadata) to its column in the count
matrix. Sample names are normalized to a `donor_sample_barcode` key (e.g.
`2462_2007_CTATAC`), dropping any `MV_`/`V3_` prefix so the matrix and metadata
line up. Produces `sample_info`, the table DESeq2 needs.

```{r match-conditions}
# Metadata columns are unnamed, so reference by position:
#   [4]  = CONDITION
#   [18] = full sample name (e.g. "sample_2462_2007_..._fastq")
meta_condition <- meta[[4]]
meta_fullname  <- sub("^sample_", "", sub("_fastq$", "", meta[[18]]))

# Normalize both sides to "donor_sample_barcode"
strip    <- function(x) sub("^([0-9]+_[0-9]+_[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", x)
mat_key  <- strip(colnames(mat))
meta_key <- strip(sub("^(MV_|V3_)", "", meta_fullname))

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(mat),
  condition = meta_condition[match(mat_key, meta_key)],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

table(sample_info$condition, useNA = "ifany")   # watch for <NA> = unmatched
```

Drop any unmatched samples, keeping the matrix and `sample_info` in sync.

```{r drop-unmatched}
keep_matched <- !is.na(sample_info$condition)

mat         <- mat[, keep_matched]
sample_info <- sample_info[keep_matched, ]

cat("Samples remaining:", ncol(mat), "\n")
table(sample_info$condition, useNA = "ifany")
```

## 6. Save outputs

```{r save}
write.csv(mat,         file.path(work_dir, "miRNA_counts_matrix.csv"))
write.csv(sample_info, file.path(work_dir, "sample_info.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved miRNA_counts_matrix.csv and sample_info.csv to", work_dir, "\n")
```
